speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; to begin my evaluation, have you experienced any fever, nausea, vomiting, or changes in your bowel habits recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular torsion. Given the sudden onset of lower abdominal pain during physical activity in a 16-year-old male, accompanied by unprotected sexual history and asthma, this presentation is highly concerning for torsion of the testicle, which can present with referred pain to the abdomen. I need to examine his testicles immediately to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes like epididymitis or appendicitis.
